title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Rate Card Note: Returning-Customer Rate on the Alignment Correction Fee
content:
The returning-customer rate on the correction fee of an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is **0.85** where the vehicle has a network insurance claim repair delivered no more than 730 days before the authorization and that repair's class is a structural class (its name contains Structural); it is **0.92** where that repair was delivered no more than 730 days before and is of a non-structural class, or was delivered more than 730 but no more than 1460 days before; otherwise it is **1**.

The rate acts on the tier's alignment correction fee itself, and the rated correction fee is rounded to the cent, half up.

## Records the rate is read from

The rate is read from the vehicle's Insurance Claim Repairs record with the network: the repair's delivered date and its repair class name; a class is structural where its name contains the word Structural. Days are calendar days counted from the delivered date to the day the customer authorizes the correction, the delivered date not counted. Where the vehicle has no delivered network insurance claim repair on record, the days are taken as 99999 and the rate is 1.

## Rate table

| Days from the claim repair's delivery to the authorization | Structural class | Non-structural class |
|---|---|---|
| no more than 730 | 0.85 | 0.92 |
| more than 730, no more than 1460 | 0.92 | 0.92 |
| more than 1460, or no delivered claim repair | 1 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Delivered 730 days before the authorization, structural class: 0.85; delivered 731 days before, structural class: 0.92.
- Delivered 1460 days before: 0.92; delivered 1461 days before: 1.

## Illustration (hypothetical correction fee of 129.95 USD)

At 0.85: 129.95 multiplied by 0.85 is 110.4575, rated at 110.46 USD. At 0.92: 119.554, rated at 119.55 USD.
